lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits. The spots are organized into approximately five discernible vertical columns between the pectoral fin and the mid-flank, with the highest-intensity clusters located in the dorsal-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal ridges; high-luminance blobs are precisely positioned at these intersections, forming a lattice-like arrangement across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity pixel values on the dorsal edge and lower-intensity shadow values on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two remoras are visible attached to the ventral region near the pectoral fin base.
